assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production landscape crafting workbench backdrop for an antique fantasy cartography dice game, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: a hunter artisan's CURVED-EDGE WOODEN WORKTABLE with an opened pale leather tool mat and a large blank recipe parchment, viewed almost directly from above. This will carry real interactive crafting controls in its center.
Style: antique fantasy atlas illustration, warm parchment ground, fine sepia/charcoal engraved outlines and selective parallel/crosshatched strokes, very low-saturation translucent watercolor. All shapes and volumes are visibly drawn in ink, color is a pale thin wash with paper showing through. The same drawing language as a vintage illustrated medieval village map. Light ochre timber, warm grey leather, ivory paper, faint sage and slate accents, a tiny muted red thread. Flat, lightly printed, airy. No photographic wood grain, no realistic textures or metal reflections, no glossy 3D, no dramatic lighting or shadows, no gritty dark brown tabletop.
Physical design: broad light wooden tabletop with subtly expanded left/right tool wings and a shallow concave curved cutout along its bottom edge, giving the worktable a recognisable silhouette. A modest tool rail occupies only the upper 12% with a few hanging small tools. LEFT PERIPHERY: a few sewing needles, thread spools, coiled cord, folded grey leather and small bone fragments. RIGHT PERIPHERY: small mortar and pestle, two little muted green glass bottles, scissors and a small clamp. Keep props restrained and entirely around the outer edges, not a crowded workshop.
Critical functional layout: an opened pale grey-beige leather mat fills the middle, with a large completely EMPTY light ivory recipe parchment on top occupying x18%-84%, y22%-86%. This central region must be utterly blank, uniformly pale and low contrast for HTML controls and readable numbers; no drawings, tray outlines, seams, marks or text inside. No ingredients or product drawn in the center. The curved bottom rim stays below y89%; the blank center remains rectangular enough to receive controls.
Backdrop: softly aged ivory parchment outside the table, complete opaque frame; understated fade into parchment around outer silhouette.
Constraints: no people, no anvils or large furnace, no glowing magic circle, no text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, dice, UI controls, buttons, grid or drawn interface. This is the art layer only.

Use case: style-transfer / portrait recomposition.
Asset type: mobile PORTRAIT production crafting-workbench backdrop, portrait 2:3.
Input image: the new curved wooden crafting table is the authoritative style, materials and object-design reference.
Primary request: recompose this same hunter artisan's curved-edge wooden worktable for a narrow phone screen. Match its exact fine sepia engraved contour drawing, delicate selective hatching, low-saturation translucent watercolor, pale ochre timber, warm grey leather and light ivory parchment. Keep it clearly drawn on paper, flat and airy.
Composition: near-overhead view, a narrow curved-bottom wooden table with two modest side wings and a shallow concave cutout at its lower edge. Small simple tool rail confined to the top 12%; a few needles, thread spools and rope at the far LEFT edge; a small mortar, tiny muted green bottle and scissors at the far RIGHT edge. Use fewer props than the landscape, never crowded. An opened pale leather pad fills the center, with a large absolutely blank ivory recipe parchment spanning x12%-88%, y20%-86%. This central rectangle must be clean, low contrast, evenly pale and empty to hold real HTML ingredient slots, product and a button. Do not draw any trays, seams, marks or objects inside the empty paper. Keep the paper broad enough for two ingredient controls side by side.
Outside the table silhouette is warm light parchment. Curved bottom edge and little wooden feet sit below y89%, subtle hand printed edges. Recompose naturally for portrait, never squeeze a landscape.
Constraints: opaque background; no text, labels, letters, numbers, watermark, people, anvil, big furnace, dice, magical glow, UI, grid or controls. No photorealism, glossy 3D, photographic wood, realistic reflections or dramatic shadows.
